sources.name: CBE - Consumer Protection: Know Your Rights (23 Mar 2023)
Lightspark - Egypt Instant Payments: Rails, Fees, and the Lightning Network (10 Oct 2025)

notes: The corpus contains the CBE's consumer-protection instructions as a web summary, not the instrument itself, so time bars are the ones the CBE page states. No liability-shift or reimbursement percentage for unauthorised transactions appears in any document here, and none is asserted.

entries.subject: complaint_reference_number_sla
entries.display: Reference number within 2 business days (immediately as a rule)
entries.quote: When a complaint is submitted, the bank shall receive the complaint and provide the consumer with its reference number immediately or within a maximum of two business days from submission date.
entries.notes: The bank must give the reference immediately, or at most within two business days.

entries.subject: complaint_response_sla
entries.display: Bank must answer within 15 business days
entries.quote: The consumer's complaint shall be answered within a period not exceeding 15 business days from the date of its receipt, except for complaints related to transactions with third parties.
entries.notes: Complaints about transactions with third parties are carved out of the 15-day clock.

entries.subject: objection_window
entries.display: 15 business days to object to the first response
entries.quote: In case the consumer is not satisfied with the response of the bank, the complaint shall be re-submitted and the bank shall be notified in written form within a maximum of 15 business days from the date of the consumer receipt of the first response, with an explanation of the objection reason.
entries.notes: The objection must be in writing, with reasons.

entries.subject: silence_is_acceptance
entries.value_text: implicit acceptance of the bank's response
entries.display: No objection within 15 business days means acceptance
entries.quote: In case the complainant doesn’t submit an objection for a period of 15 business days from the date of receiving the response from the bank, this shall be considered as an implicit acceptance of the response.
entries.notes: A common misconception is that the complaint stays open indefinitely.

entries.subject: resubmission_response_sla
entries.display: A further 15 business days to answer a resubmitted complaint
entries.quote: The bank will respond to the resubmitted complaint within a maximum of additional 15 business days.
entries.notes: Total worst case for a contested complaint is about 45 business days before escalation.

entries.subject: escalation_to_cbe
entries.value_text: no response in time, or the second response is refused
entries.display: Escalate to the CBE if the bank misses the clock or the second answer fails
entries.quote: The consumer has the right to escalate the complaint to the Central Bank of Egypt in case that no response has been received within the prescribed period or the second response from the bank is not accepted.
entries.notes: Complaints go to CBE headquarters or the CBE website; the CBE is not the first port of call.

entries.subject: bank_consumer_protection_unit
entries.value_text: an independent consumer protection unit in each bank
entries.display: Every bank must run an independent consumer protection unit
entries.quote: The Consumer Protection Unit is the entity established at banks in accordance with the regulations of consumer protection for banks issued by the Central Bank of Egypt, and it is an independent unit at the bank specialized in dealing with, managing and resolving consumer complaints.
entries.notes: Set up under the CBE consumer protection regulations for banks. [normalised: categorical answer, grade with quote]

entries.subject: consumer_protection_rules_date
entries.display: CBE Consumer Protection Instructions date from February 2019
entries.quote: the Central Bank of Egypt has issued the Consumer Protection Instructions for banks in February 2019, in order to set clear foundations governing the relationship between banks and their consumers in all stages of dealings.
entries.notes: The IPN rules (4-3) require participants to comply with these instructions and their amendments.

entries.subject: statutory_consumer_protection_articles
entries.display: Consumer protection powers sit in articles 216-220 of Law 194/2020
entries.quote: Articles 216 to 220 stipulated the Central Bank’s competencies regarding consumer protection.

entries.subject: complaint_channels
entries.value_text: call centre, website, branches, fax or email
entries.display: Four ways to file: call centre, website, branch, fax/email
entries.quote: Banks’ call center. The bank’s website. Through the different branches of the bank. Other electronic means such as fax and email.

entries.subject: fraud_reporting_step
entries.value_text: go to the nearest branch and/or call the bank's call centre immediately
entries.display: Report fraud to the branch or call centre at once
entries.quote: In case of any fraud or theft happening on your accounts or the loss of any bank cards ( all kind of cards), you must head immediately to the nearest branch of the bank and/or contact your bank’s call center to report the case , so that the bank can take the necessary measures immediately upon being notified.
entries.notes: The CBE's own advice; the bank then has to act on the notification. No statutory refund figure is stated in the corpus.

entries.subject: completed_transfer_irrevocability
entries.value_text: no; only failed transactions reverse automatically
entries.display: A successful InstaPay payment cannot be reversed
entries.quote: real-time payments in Egypt, such as those on the InstaPay network, are irrevocable once successfully completed, although failed transactions are automatically reversed.
entries.notes: Recovery after a misdirected successful transfer depends on the recipient's consent or a refund flow, not a chargeback.
